name: Export user
description: Export a user's whole stored state as one value for user:import: workspace, agents and their sessions, jobs, assets, operations, HITL inbox and secrets. Secrets are sealed together to accountKey with Convex ECIES, never exported in the clear or under the venue's key; secrets:false leaves them out. State the venue keeps outside the user's record (login aliases and authenticators, drives, adapter-owned state, scheduled events, content bytes) is not included, and references to it are carried as stored. Refused while the user has a job not yet finished or an agent task outstanding. A direct result-only run (POST /run): recorded jobs, MCP tools, agents, sessions and nested operation calls are refused. Use the published definition unchanged. Exporting another user requires venue-issued user/export on <venueDID>/users.

did.description: User DID; defaults to the authenticated caller

accountKey.description: 32-byte Ed25519 public key to seal the user's secrets to, as a blob or hexadecimal (optional 0x prefix). Required when the user has secrets, unless secrets is false.

secrets.description: false leaves the user's secrets out of the export

export.description: The export: a CAD3 multi-cell encoding as a 0x-prefixed hexadecimal string.
